QuestInfo.name: [Chu Chu] Eree Valley's Catch of the Day 2
QuestInfo.0: Pimi, the second oldest of the Pi siblings, is helping you and Simia pick out ingredients. Her taste for seafood is second to none. Enlist her aid in assembling the fish patty.
QuestInfo.1:
Pimi, the second oldest of the Pi siblings, is helping you and Simia pick out ingredients. Her taste for seafood is second to none.

Pimi tells you to get Crunchy Shells from Rhyturtles and Soft Shells from Boss Rhyturtle.
QuestInfo.2: Pimi can be a little frightening some times, but she really cares for her siblings. You completed the fish patty with her help. Her choice of ingredients was as strange as her personality, but they didn't taste that bad. Still, you could go for a taste of home about now.

default.0: I see you haven't gotten all the ingredients yet. That's okay. We'll just have to make a smaller sandwich and maybe Muto'll starve I guess. No big deal.
